$comment: Every vendored file under assets/ and every remote file the engine fetches, with its source and licence. tooling/check-licences.mjs fails on an unlisted file or a licence outside the allow-list; tooling/fetch-models.mjs and the runtime loader check the remote hashes.

local.description: NAVER Anny body model baked by tooling/bake/bake_anny.py: adult PCA body basis, face modifiers, ARKit-named facial actions, 104-bone skin.
local.licenceNote: Code Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); data/mpfb2 (MakeHuman/MPFB2 assets) and data/faceunits01 (Face Units, Mika Suominen) CC0-1.0. Default 'anny' topology only; no SMPL/SMPL-X assets.

local.description: Correspondence from MediaPipe Face Landmarker points to the Anny mesh, calibrated by this repo's tooling on synthetic renders.
Body feature calibration and the learned face/body priors (ridge regressions), trained by this repo's tooling/calibrate on synthetic people rendered from Anny.

Hair catalogue: geometry derived from CC0 MakeHuman hair (short02, short03, afro01, bob02, long01, ponytail01, braid01 from the system assets; littleright_bobcut_hair from Hair 01), re-bound to Anny's head by tooling/bake/hair/bake_hair.py. No textures: transparent card areas were cut away and strand brightness kept as a per-vertex shade.

sources.licenceProof: Asset-pack page: 'System assets and materials for system assets, shared under CC0: MakeHuman system assets'; each .mhclo header: 'This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020.'
https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/hair01.html lists littleright_bobcut_hair (author littleright) as CC0; packs/hair01.json in the zip: license CC0.
